name: Workbench crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Repair, refill, bundle, refurbish. ECONOMY.md's workbench.

name: Smelter crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. The old furnace on cells: two ore into one bar, slag out.

name: Recycler crate
desc: Any item into its materials as unit items; 10% to sludge. Generic rule, no written recipes.

name: Crusher crate
desc: Breaks mixed scrap, e-waste and ice into sorted unit items, better than the recycler for raw lots.

name: Purifier crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Greywater or ice into clean water; a filter wears.

name: Charger crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Refills spent cells from station power; billed in credits at the power price.

name: Hydro tray crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Seed, water, nutrient and a lamp; grows over nights.

name: Wired terminal crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Runs programs from discs; mail, orders, remote for machines.

name: Modem crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Plugs into the terminal: mail, orders, boards. No modem, no mail.

name: Slip printer crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Small print surface: order slips, labels, receipts.

name: Box sealer crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Seals a packed box (mod_sealed). A sealed box opens only with a knife.

name: Scanner crate
desc: Reveals hidden modifiers (virus, counterfeit), composition and contraband flags.

name: Radio crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Engineers' chatter: rumors earlier and likelier right. Effects only.

name: Digester crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Sludge into biomass, salts, gas and water over nights.

name: Vat crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Biomass paste into rations, salami, cheese, bread. Recipe disc required.

name: Fabricator crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Bars and polymer into parts, tools, filters, housings. Blueprint disc required.

name: Extruder crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Polymer flake into sheet, tube and film.

name: Kiln crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Grit and slag into glass, vials, ceramics.

name: Electrolyser crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Water into oxygen and hydrogen. Drinks cells.

name: Scrubber crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Pulls carbon out of foul air; cartridges wear.

name: Algae tank crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Green water: biomass and oxygen from light, salts and gas.

name: Still crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Ferments and distils: ethanol, spirit, wine, distilled water.

name: Chem bench crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Reagents, antiseptic, coolant, lubricant, solvents.

name: Pill press crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Reagent and filler into pills and blisters.

name: Loom crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Fibre into cloth, gauze, garments.

name: Pulper crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Rags and lint into paper.

name: Galley crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Hot plate on cells, no flame: meals from vat food and crops.

name: Document printer crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Medium print surface: manuals, posters, books in sheets.

name: Labeller crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Puts a grade or licence label on goods (mod_label_*). Disc sets the label.

name: Disc copier crate
desc: A disc plus a blank of the same media into two. Generic rule; licensed discs refuse.

name: Chiller crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Pulls heat from a neighbour: clears Hot, slows overclock wear.

name: Vent port crate
desc: The outflow port: vents sludge and waste off station for a fee. Matter leaves the loop here.

name: Hydro rack crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Tall racks under lamps: fruit, herbs, fibre crops.

name: Industrial vat crate
desc: Big-batch vat on a pallet. Takes the first vat's feed lines; bring the old one as the reference.

name: Precision fabricator crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Tight tolerances: bearings, valves, machine parts, phase 3 machines.

name: 3D printer crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Reads models from a memory card; prints polymer and light metal.

name: Assembler crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Boards, chips and housings into devices and computers.

name: Cell press crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Makes power cells from lithium, metal and reagent.

name: Synthesiser crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Builds molecules: drugs, new polymer from carbon and gas.

name: Cellar crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Cold, dark, patient: ages cheese and wine over nights (mod_aged).

name: Jeweller's bench crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Noble metal and stones into rings, lockets, engraving.

name: Annealer crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Tempers tools and parts (mod_tempered): more uses, more worth.

name: Banner printer crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Large print surface: banners, art prints, ad sheets.

name: Broadcaster crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Ads on the deck feeds: more buyers of one need for a while.

name: Workstation crate
desc: A workstation in a steel case. The wired terminal stays as the second seat.

name: Autofab crate
desc: Industrial fabricator in three crates. Needs the precision fabricator to calibrate against.

name: Bioreactor crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Digester and vat in one tank: sludge in, culture food out.

name: Mainframe crate
desc: Runs automation for every machine at once; hosts the black-market client at scale.

name: Refinery crate
desc: Crated on the outside counter. Recovers rare earths and noble metal from e-waste and slag.

name: Vat staples disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Ration bars, paste, protein blocks.

name: Vat bakery disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Bread loaves, crackers.

name: Vat dairy disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Cheese wheels and spreads.

name: Vat charcuterie disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Salami and cured vat meats.

name: Vat gourmet disc
desc: Card by mail. Ring-grade vat food.

name: Hydro greens disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Greens, sprouts, beans.

name: Hydro orchard disc
desc: Card by mail. Dwarf fruit: apples, citrus, berries.

name: Bio cultures disc
desc: Card by mail. Culture food straight from sludge.

name: Algae strains disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Fast and dense algae strains.

name: Scrubber profiles disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Carbon capture and gas sorting profiles.

name: Hardware blueprints disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Fasteners, sheet goods, pipe, tins.

name: Tool blueprints disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Knives, wrenches, hand tools.

name: Spares blueprints disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Spare parts, housings, brackets.

name: Precision blueprints disc
desc: Card by mail. Bearings, valves, seals.

name: Fittings models disc
desc: Card by mail. Printed brackets, clips, fittings.

name: Polymer synthesis disc
desc: Card by mail. New polymer from carbon and gas.

name: Heavy blueprints disc
desc: Card by mail. Hull plate, frames, big structural.

name: Refining profiles disc
desc: Card by mail. Rare and noble recovery.

name: Circuit blueprints disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Boards, cables, sensors.

name: Lamp blueprints disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Grow lamps, work lights.

name: Cell blueprints disc
desc: Card by mail. Cell chemistry.

name: Device blueprints disc
desc: Card by mail. Radios, handsets, scanners, small devices.

name: Computer blueprints disc
desc: Card by mail. Terminals and workstations.

name: Gadget models disc
desc: Card by mail. Printed gadgets and cases.

name: Automata blueprints disc
desc: Card by mail. Service drones and loader arms.

name: Mail program disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Mail and orders.

name: Labels program disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Prints order slips and labels.

name: Ledger program disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Day summary by need and event.

name: Board program disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Live need prices and trend arrows.

name: Scrub program disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Finds and strips mod_infected.

name: Overclock program disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Modifier: machine jobs cheaper, jam risk up.

name: Wholesale program disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Wholesale account client: crates at market price.

name: Diagnostics program disc
desc: Floppy by mail. See all machine statuses remotely.

name: Forecast program disc
desc: Card by mail. Rumors earlier and more often right.

name: Automate program disc
desc: Card by mail. Scripts load and start machine jobs.

name: Model store program disc
desc: Card by mail. Buy 3D models onto cards.

name: Tracker and chess disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Module tunes and a chess board.

name: Dockmaster program disc
desc: Floppy by mail. What ships, which box, what each pays.

name: Utility program disc
desc: Card by mail. Defrag, mail cipher and bench tuner.

name: Chemistry basics disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Ethanol, antiseptic, saline.

name: Analgesics disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Painkillers.

name: Sedatives disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Sleeping pills, calmers.

name: Stimulants disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Stims and energy tabs.

name: Antibiotics disc
desc: Card by mail. Antibiotics and antivirals.

name: Regenerative disc
desc: Card by mail. Ring medicine: regrowth gels, gene patches.

name: Vintner disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Wine and spirits.

name: Garment patterns disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Garments and furnishings.

name: Perfumery disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Scents, soaps, cosmetics.

name: Jewellery models disc
desc: Card by mail. Rings, chains, lockets.

name: Art models disc
desc: Card by mail. Sculpture and ornament models.

name: Machine plans, first disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Build phase 1 machines.

name: Machine plans, second disc
desc: Card by mail. Build phase 2 machines.

name: Machine plans, third disc
desc: Card by mail. Build phase 3 machines.

name: Filter blueprints disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Water filters and air cartridges.

name: Consumables disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Coolant and lubricant.

name: Ring labels disc
desc: Floppy by mail. Ring-grade labels (mod_label_ring).

name: Company labels disc
desc: Card by mail. Company licence labels (mod_label_company).

name: Shop extension
desc: Knock through the next bay along: four more columns of floor, then four more rows.

name: Second bay
desc: The unit behind yours, rented off the Mid Decks board. Walls out, floor in.

name: Workshop hall
desc: A foundry-side hall with a load-rated floor. Room for assemblers and their cradles.

name: Concern floor
desc: A full deck section leased from the Company: gantry rails, clear height, its own lifts.

name: Dock extension
desc: Two more rows on the dock grid and, later, two more columns: more boxes per pickup.

name: Dock gantry
desc: A rail and hoist over the dock apron. Large boxes stop being a two-person job.

name: Folding cot
desc: Canvas on a steel frame, set up behind the stock. One decent night changes the morning.

name: Bunk
desc: A proper frame with a locker under it and a curtain. The spine sleeps four high; you sleep one.

name: Crew berth
desc: Light-metal berth with a foam pad, a reading lamp and a door that shuts.

name: Ring cabin
desc: A ring-grade sleeping cabin: real wood veneer, a window onto the stars, quiet.

name: Cell bank
desc: A racked charging frame: cells sit in it between jobs and take on a little more.

name: Night tariff
desc: A signed schedule with the reactor desk: charge at the dead hours, pay the dead-hour price.

name: Extractor hood
desc: Ducted hood over the machine row. Less heat and dust in the works means fewer jams.

name: Load governor
desc: A rack unit that staggers every machine's start. Same work, a lighter bill in effort.

name: Display case
desc: Glass-fronted, lit from inside. Things behind glass are worth what the buyer imagines.

name: Locked vitrine
desc: A tall locked cabinet for rings, lockets and anything a collector would ask to hold.

name: Shelf unit
desc: Open steel shelving, bolted to the deck. Holds whatever you stack on it.

name: Bookshelf
desc: Another bookshelf, for paper and anything flat. Opening it takes a window.

name: Steel cabinet
desc: A grey cabinet that holds more than it looks. Doors shut; things stay put.

name: Disc holder
desc: A polymer rack with slots for floppies and cards. Keeps the labels facing out.

name: Cold cabinet
desc: A chilled cabinet for cheese, salami and anything fresh. Buyers pay more for cold.

name: Parts locker
desc: Forty small bins behind a steel door. Fasteners, bearings and valves, sorted for once.

name: Ledger book
desc: A bound book and a pencil on a string. Each evening you write down what sold and why.

name: Price board
desc: A screen on the wall showing live need prices, fed from the spine's counting house.

name: Roof aerial
desc: A mast through the ceiling tiles. Engineers' chatter comes in clearer and sooner.

name: Pigeonholes
desc: A wall of paper slots for slips and notices. Senders find a shop that answers.

name: Shop sign
desc: Stencilled letters on a lit panel above the shutter. The corridor starts to know your name.

name: Ad board
desc: A hung board with a rotating strip: one need advertised at a time, to whoever walks past.

name: Second counter
desc: A second till and a second pair of hands at it. The queue splits and moves.

name: Extra pickup
desc: The Account tier buys a half-day slot on the carrier's round. Sealed boxes leave sooner.

name: Fee schedule
desc: A negotiated box-fee schedule for Account holders. Printed, stamped, filed in the pigeonholes.

name: Priority lane
desc: Bonded boxes ride the priority sled. A day off every transit, on every deck.

name: Carrier contract
desc: A signed contract with the parcel carrier: cheaper boxes, a second daily pickup.

name: Wholesale account
desc: A trade account with the dock stores: crates ordered by terminal at market price.

name: Floor safe
desc: A bolted steel box with a dial. Heirlooms, cash and discs go in; inspectors look elsewhere.

name: Strongroom
desc: A plated cell behind the stockroom wall. Fire, drugs and cracked discs sleep here.

name: Breakdown cover
desc: A policy with a mid-deck broker: a spare part ships the morning after you report a jam.

name: First hand
desc: A hired hand and a bench to work at. They run jobs while you sleep and stay out of the till.

effects.text: a second hand: +2 energy per day
a third hand: +2 energy per day

name: Ring frontage
desc: A stall on the Ring promenade. Real light, real rent, buyers who carry real money.

name: Memory bank
desc: Four chips on a card, pressed into the terminal's spare socket. More windows, fewer refusals.

name: Hard disk
desc: A drive in a steel sled. Programs live on C: instead of riding in on floppies.

name: Port hub
desc: A grey box with four sockets. The terminal stops being the only thing you plug into.
